scope: Original FinQA V25 nine-model B replication and predefined descriptive comparison with A; fixed known 1147-task test benchmark.
extraction_method: Transcription of sealed score summaries and model reports; deterministic aggregation only. No model generation, API calls, GPU work, rescoring, bootstrap, or p-value calculation.

conclusions.primary: B Full-Static native execution accuracy: positive mean difference, but the predefined seed-level 95% interval includes zero; superiority is not confirmed.
conclusions.key_secondary: B Full-C-only native execution accuracy: negative mean difference and interval includes zero; no confirmed positive incremental benefit of Full over C-only.

units_and_definitions.accuracy_and_contrast_unit: fraction; multiply by 100 for percent accuracy or percentage-point difference
units_and_definitions.sample_sd_unit: same as corresponding accuracy or difference; sample SD uses ddof=1
units_and_definitions.repeated_task_denominator: 3441 = 3 seeds x the same 1147 tasks; 6882 = 6 seeds x the same tasks. These are repeated model-task observations, not independent new tasks.
units_and_definitions.invalid_prediction: Native evaluator invalid_prediction status, comprising missing_or_invalid_submission and nonexecutable_submission; do not label every invalid prediction as a pure formatting error.
units_and_definitions.unknown: Missing/unknown native metric outcomes are reported separately; invalid predictions are explicit native zero scores, not unknown outcomes silently converted to zero.
units_and_definitions.native_status_scored_vs_metric_scored: native_status_counts.scored excludes invalid_prediction; metrics.*.scored includes determinate invalid-prediction zero scores.
units_and_definitions.native_metric_scope: Native execution/program accuracy does not measure reasoning-trace or process reliability.
units_and_definitions.source_checksums: Official summary/model SHA-256 values are transcribed from their sealed references, not rehashed as a redundant integrity check; scoring_result SHA-256 is computed from the bytes read for this extraction.

deterministic_formulas.arm_correct_total: sum over included seeds of model.metrics[metric].correct
deterministic_formulas.arm_mean: arithmetic mean of per-seed complete_dataset_mean; equal seed weights
deterministic_formulas.arm_minimum_maximum: min/max of included per-seed accuracy values
deterministic_formulas.arm_invalid_count_fraction: sum model native invalid_prediction counts; divide by n_seeds * 1147
deterministic_formulas.invalid_prediction_reason_counts: count each stored result native.reason conditional on native.status == invalid_prediction; no re-evaluation
deterministic_formulas.paired_difference: Reported official within-seed positive-arm minus negative-arm accuracy; paired wins-losses divided by 1147
deterministic_formulas.paired_counts: Transcribed official wins/ties/losses; no new paired-task significance test
deterministic_formulas.reported_seed_t95: Transcribed official B interval only: mean_difference +/- 4.3026527299 * sample_sd / sqrt(3), df=2; no new interval calculated

statistics.combined_six_seeds: predefined descriptive equal weighting only; report old/new blocks first; no pooled CI
statistics.estimate: equal-weight mean of the three within-seed paired accuracy differences

statistics.combined_six_seeds: predefined descriptive equal weighting only; report old/new blocks first; no pooled CI
statistics.design: prospectively locked new training-seed replication on known benchmark
statistics.estimate: equal-weight mean of the three within-seed paired accuracy differences

execution_interval.assumption: independent identically distributed approximately normal seed effects; strong untestable assumption at n=3
execution_interval.unit: independent training seed; fixed known test benchmark

seed_t95.unit: training seed, conditional on fixed known benchmark
training seed, conditional on fixed known benchmark

six_seed_descriptive.paired_counts_reference: Same per-seed official paired counts already preserved in blocks.A and blocks.B; not duplicated here.
